label.description: Which snapshot this is: baseline (pre-opt), current (live ranking), or final (post-opt).

basis.description: How the ranking was built: e2e-workload = wall-clock share of a real workload (application); kernel-suite = per-kernel benchmark runtime (library, no single driver). Default e2e-workload.

workload.description: The e2e workload/command profiled (application); for a library, the kernel-benchmark suite that was timed.

cases.description: When multiple e2e cases were aggregated into this ranking: the cases and the weight each contributed.

evidence.description: Run id of this case's e2e record (raw workload log + timing).

REQUIRED on the immutable baseline/final snapshots: run id(s) of the e2e records behind this ranking — one per case. This is what backs the headline speedup in the final report. `verify` (E4) fails a snapshot with no record; (E7) fails when baseline and final ran on different env fingerprints.

method.description: How wall-clock was attributed: unitrace device-timing | unitrace slice | in-app sycl::event timers. A fallback method must be stated here so the report does not overclaim precision.

ranking.description: Kernels ordered by descending share of e2e wall-clock (optimization priority).
